flaws.B: The breath follows the beats exactly but is made of rigid 1 px part shifts, so it is subtle and a little cut-out-like at 1x.
flaws.S: Slight redraw noise on the face and hair in frames 1-2 makes the head shimmer against the pixel-exact frame 0.
flaws.D: Everything rises and falls together (the sword lifts with the chest in frame 1) and the face is lightly redrawn each frame, so the breath boils and lacks overlap.
flaws.H: Frames 1-3 gain a purple outline fringe and a redrawn face, so the loop flickers in colour at 0->1 and 3->0.

flaws.M: The head and shield shoot up 4 px with a taller, frontal-faced redraw in frames 1-2, so the idle bounces and the character visibly changes size.
